title: Agentic Inequality
abstract: arXiv:2510.16853v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous AI agents capable of complex planning and action mark a shift beyond today's generative tools. As these systems enter political and economic life, who can access them, how capable they are, and how many can be deployed will shape distributions of power and opportunity. We define this emerging challenge as "agentic inequality": disparities in power, opportunity, and outcomes arising from unequal access to, and capabilities of, AI agents. We show that agents could either deepen existing divides or, under the right conditions, mitigate them. The paper makes three contributions. First, it develops a framework for analysing agentic inequality across three dimensions: availability, quality, and quantity. Second, it argues that agentic inequality differs from earlier technological divides because agents function as autonomous delegates rather than tools, generating new asymmetries through scalable goal delegation and direct

translated_abstract: 摘要：能够进行复杂规划与行动的自主AI智能体，标志着超越当今生成式工具的一次转变。随着这些系统进入政治和经济生活，谁能使用它们、它们能力如何、以及能部署多少，将塑造权力与机会的分配格局。我们将这一新兴挑战定义为“智能体不平等”：即源于对AI智能体获取机会不平等和能力差异而产生的权力、机会与结果上的差距。我们表明，智能体既可能加深现有的分化，也可能在适当条件下缓解这些分化。本文做出了三项贡献。第一，开发了一个从三个维度分析智能体不平等的框架：可得性、质量和数量。第二，论证了智能体不平等与早期的技术鸿沟不同，因为智能体作为自主的代理人而非工具发挥作用，通过可扩展的目标委托和直接的（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“智能体不平等”这一新概念，指自主AI智能体在获取机会与能力上的差异会带来权力、机会和结果的不平等，并从可得性、质量和数量三个维度构建分析框架，指出智能体既可能加深也可能缓解现有的社会分化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "agentic inequality"—disparities in power, opportunity, and outcomes arising from unequal access to and capabilities of AI agents—and proposes a three-dimensional framework (availability, quality, quantity) showing that autonomous agents could either deepen or mitigate existing societal divides.
